title: bomify plugin Result
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout on success, per plugins/CONTRACT.md. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one object) against this schema to check it for structural conformance.

outputPath.description: For pull: the local path the artifact was written to (normally --output, echoed back). For push: the reference the artifact was published under at --remote.

message.description: Optional, human-readable summary of what happened. Omit this key entirely rather than sending an empty string.

hash.description: May be omitted entirely, or present as {} or with both fields set — bomify parses a missing key and an empty object identically. algorithm and value are either both present or both absent.

algorithm.description: Must exactly equal the --hash value the plugin was given.

value.description: The digest, hex-encoded. Case-insensitive; lowercase is the convention every first-party plugin follows.
